basis: Global oversampling showed positive multiplicity-adjusted inflation; global preprocessing and feature selection did not.
The median contrast was positive, but the Holm-adjusted test was not significant.
The moderator likelihood-ratio test was not significant and matched fractions did not show a consistent increase as sample size decreased.
The feature-to-sample moderator likelihood-ratio test was not significant and stratified associations were inconsistent.
Inflation varied with minority prevalence most clearly for global oversampling, but mixed-model residual and variance diagnostics failed.
Flexible model families showed larger oversampling inflation, but mixed-model residual and variance diagnostics failed.
